architecture.pattern: Clean Architecture / MVVM with Offline-First Repository & MediaSessionService
layers: Data (NewPipeExtractor Client, InnerTube API Client, Room DB, EncryptedSharedPreferences, Media3 DownloadManager, Repositories)
Playback Engine (AndroidX MediaSessionService, ExoPlayer 1.4.1, AudioOnly Player Adapter)
Presentation (Jetpack Compose UI, Material 3, Accessibility Semantics, ViewModels)
architecture.a11y_strategy: Strict Screen Reader Optimization (TalkBack and Jieshuo/CSR): explicit contentDescription without emoji noise, liveRegion for async search/sync/playback feedback, custom accessibility actions for list items, minimum 48dp touch targets, semantic state announcements, trap-free WebView dialogs.
architecture.persistence: AndroidX Room (SQLite) for Subscriptions, Playback Resume State, Download Records; EncryptedSharedPreferences for Auth Cookies and Session Tokens; SimpleCache for Audio Chunks

requirements.title: Pure Audio Only Stream Extraction & Playback
requirements.description: Zero video rendering engine. Stream audio directly using NewPipeExtractor to retrieve audio-only formats (m4a/opus/webm) and play via Media3 ExoPlayer with lockscreen MediaSession controls and background playback support.
requirements.verification_criteria: ExoPlayer plays audio stream with screen off / in background without decoding video buffers; notification controls respond to play/pause/seek.

requirements.title: Offline Audio Downloading & Cache Management
requirements.description: Full offline download support prioritizing audio streams. Downloads managed via Media3 DownloadManager/Downloader with metadata tracked in Room DB. Support pausing, resuming, deleting, and offline playback without network access.
requirements.verification_criteria: Audio file downloaded completely to cache/storage, appears in offline downloads list, and plays without internet connection.

requirements.title: Resume Playback Position Tracking
requirements.description: Persist user playback progress in Room database periodically and on pause/stop. Upon opening an audio item, prompt or automatically resume from last saved timestamp unless completed (>95%).
requirements.verification_criteria: Stopping audio at 05:23 and reopening resumes at 05:23; completed tracks reset position.

requirements.title: Local Channel Subscriptions & Feed Ingestion
requirements.description: Maintain 100% on-device local channel subscriptions in Room database. Allow user to subscribe/unsubscribe without Google account login. Aggregate latest feed items from subscribed channels via NewPipeExtractor.
requirements.verification_criteria: User can subscribe to channels locally; feed tab displays chronologically sorted audio uploads from subscribed channels.

requirements.title: Search with Instant Accessibility Readout
requirements.description: Fast audio search with immediate accessibility announcement of results count, query state, and loading progress using aria-live / liveRegion semantics.
requirements.verification_criteria: Search queries execute swiftly; screen reader immediately announces result count and states clearly.

requirements.title: Complete Screen Reader Accessibility Compliance
requirements.description: Fully tailored for TalkBack and Jieshuo (CSR) screen readers: clear concise contentDescription labels without emoji noise, semantic action labels (e.g., Download, Subscribe, Resume), linear traversal order, and high contrast.
requirements.verification_criteria: App is 100% operable with screen reader gestures, zero unlabeled buttons, unambiguous announcements for all state transitions.

requirements.title: Google / YouTube Authentication & Encrypted Credential Management
requirements.description: Secure sign-in via Android WebView bypassing error 403 using Chrome Mobile User-Agent. Extract session cookies (SAPISID, HSID, SSID, SID, LOGIN_INFO) upon authentication completion and persist them securely using AndroidX EncryptedSharedPreferences.
requirements.verification_criteria: User signs in successfully; session cookies and SAPISID are extracted and persisted in EncryptedSharedPreferences; subsequent app launches preserve login status.

requirements.title: InnerTube API Subscriptions Synchronization via SAPISIDHASH
requirements.description: Authenticate YouTube InnerTube requests using dynamic SAPISIDHASH signature over /youtubei/v1/browse with browseId FEchannels. Ingest full channel subscriptions list with pagination handling and upsert into Room Subscriptions table.
requirements.verification_criteria: API returns HTTP 200 with subscriptions payload; all subscribed channels are ingested into Room database with channelId, title, and avatarUrl.

requirements.title: Offline Google Takeout CSV Import & Export
requirements.description: Allow account-free subscription synchronization by importing subscriptions.csv exported from Google Takeout. Support selecting file via Storage Access Framework, parsing channel IDs/titles, and batch inserting into Room. Also support exporting local subscriptions to CSV.
requirements.verification_criteria: Selecting subscriptions.csv parses all rows correctly, handles commas and quotes, and populates Room database without errors or network calls.

requirements.title: Accessible Account & Subscriptions Sync Interface
requirements.description: Dedicated Compose screen and dialogs for account status, one-tap sync, CSV import/export, and logout. Strictly compliant with TalkBack and Jieshuo screen readers: explicit non-emoji contentDescription, polite liveRegion announcements for sync progress, and minimum 48dp touch targets.
requirements.verification_criteria: TalkBack and Jieshuo navigate effortlessly through login, sync, and CSV import flows with zero unlabeled elements and clear progress readouts.
